LanguageData.OMW_MulletOver_ChanceDescription: The chance that a specific mental break will trigger a haircut instead. The chance is checked only when the actual mental break is about to start, and only when a styling station is available on map. If the roll fails, or no suitable station is available, the normal mental break proceeds. Configure hair styles to be part of the mullet pool for each mental break intensity.
